timeline.event: scheduled maintenance job 'cert-rotator' completed across all 14 regions, logging 'rotated 217 certificates' with zero errors
first deploy failure in region eu-west-2, stage 'artifact verification', error: 'signature verification failed: certificate chain incomplete (missing intermediate)'
on-call pulls expanded log showing cert-bundle.internal:8443 returned HTTP 200 with an EMPTY bundle (0 certificates) for requests after 03:02, but healthy 3-certificate bundle in replay of 02:59 log

bundle service metrics show no errors or deploys; object store shows bucket-level event at 03:02:47: lifecycle rule 'purge-staging-over-30d' executed, deleting 1,142 objects from prefix 'staging/cert-intermediates/'
timeline.evidence_source: bundle service metrics and object store events

timeline.event: mitigation begins: on-call restores the staging/cert-intermediates/ prefix from cross-region replica (replication lag 9 minutes)
bundle service serving 3-certificate bundles again; remaining regions never failed as their deploys were not scheduled in the exposure window
incident mitigated: 6 regions affected, 41 deploy jobs failed, 0 customer-facing outages, 1 on-call escalation
unrelated monitoring-agent migration began rolling to 10% of fleet hosts; failing jobs' logs show verification errors on both old and new agent hosts
DNS maintenance window for internal zones started (planned, announced); resolution tests show normal latency and correct answers for cert-bundle.internal throughout
config change 12 days ago redirected cert-rotator writes to staging/cert-intermediates/ prefix; reviewed by two engineers, neither checked bucket lifecycle rules

chain: config change 12 days ago redirected cert-rotator writes to staging/cert-intermediates/ prefix
lifecycle rule 'purge-staging-over-30d' executed at 03:02:47, deleting 1,142 objects from staging/cert-intermediates/
bundle service cache served empty bundle for requests after 03:02 due to missing intermediates in source
rolling deploy schedule caused staggered onset of failures starting with eu-west-2
root_cause.single_preventing_control: require all config changes affecting data paths to include a review of associated bucket lifecycle rules
missing_alerts: certificate count metric in bundle service (to detect empty bundles)
stale-content alert for cert-bundle internal service (which did not exist)

blast_radius.customer_impact_assessment: no customer-facing outages occurred because all deploy jobs were internal to the platform; verification errors did not affect end-user services or external APIs

near_miss_exposure.exposure_reason: deploy scheduled during exposure window but failed at 03:28:00Z (not logged due to no failure alert)

remediation.fix: require all config changes affecting data paths to include a mandatory review of associated bucket lifecycle rules
remediation.verification_step: verify that a new config change for cert-rotator writes includes lifecycle rule review during approval workflow

remediation.fix: add certificate count metric to bundle service, exposed in dashboard and monitored by alert if below threshold
remediation.verification_step: validate that the metric fires when bundle has zero certificates and triggers an alert

remediation.fix: implement a health check for bundle content validity (not just HTTP 200) on bundle service endpoint
remediation.verification_step: simulate empty bundle request and confirm health check fails with non-200 status or error condition

remediation.fix: add a configuration-level guard to prevent writes to staging/cert-intermediates/ if lifecycle rules would purge them within 30 days
remediation.verification_step: test config change that redirects writes to staging prefix and confirm it is blocked by guard rule

remediation.fix: establish a post-incident review process for all configuration changes, including mandatory checklist of associated lifecycle rules and data retention policies
remediation.verification_step: audit 10 past config changes involving data paths and verify each included lifecycle rule review

correlation_discipline: The cert-rotator completion at 03:02 is temporal correlation; the causal chain runs through the object-store deletion event (03:02:47) and cache timing evidence. The rotator itself was not faulty because it completed successfully with zero errors, wrote intermediates to staging prefix as configured, and did not fail. Monitoring-agent migration at 03:05 is ruled out because verification errors occurred on both old and new agent hosts; DNS maintenance at 03:09 is ruled out because resolution tests show normal latency and correct answers for cert-bundle.internal throughout.
severity_discipline: The incident was classified as severity-one due to zero customer-facing impact (verified by no end-user service disruption), a moderate internal blast radius (6 regions, 41 failed jobs), and mitigation within 52 minutes of onset. The classification is auditable because all factors align with the board's rubric: customer impact first, then internal blast radius, then mitigation time.
